drills.title: Win It and Go
drills.format: 4v4 plus two keepers, then a 3v2 counter
drills.area: 50m x 36m, a goal at each end (7m wide), halfway line marked with cones
drills.kit: Red and Blue bibs, keepers in a third colour, plenty of balls in each goal
drills.start: Blue start with the ball on the halfway line and attack the right hand goal
setup: Blue 4 attackers (B1 to B4) against Red 4 defenders (R1 to R4) and a Red keeper at the right hand goal.
Red outlet players R5 and R6 wait on the halfway line either side of the area.
Blue recovery defenders B5 and B6 wait near the left hand goal with a Blue keeper.
rules: Blue have eight touches or one minute to shoot.
Red can only counter once they have won the ball or the keeper has made a save.
A goal for Red inside ten seconds of winning the ball counts double.
Offside applies in the right hand half only.
restart: Ball out of play or a goal: Blue restart from halfway with a new ball.
If Blue score, the keeper restarts to Red outlet players as before.
points: Go early: the first pass after the regain is forward and positive.
Run in three lanes: one wide left, one wide right, one through the middle.
The player in the middle arrives late so the defenders cannot mark them early.
Take one touch to get the ball out of your feet, then move it.
Defenders: slow the ball down, never dive in, and get goal side.
progress: Make it 5v4 on the break, then 4v4.
Add a six second limit to score from the regain.
Play the full 9v9 or 11v11 game and award bonus points for goals from regains.

drills.title: Trap and Spring
drills.format: 5v5 plus two keepers, Blue press Red from the goal kick
drills.area: 50m x 36m, a goal at each end (7m wide), halfway line marked with cones
drills.kit: Red and Blue bibs, keepers in a third colour, plenty of balls in each goal
drills.start: Red keeper starts with the ball and plays out to a centre back
setup: Blue 4 pressers (B1 to B4) plus B5 as a spare, against Red 5 (R1 to R5) and a Red keeper (KL).
Blue start in a 1 2 1 shape in Red's half. Red start with the keeper on the ball.
A second Blue keeper (KR) defends the right hand goal.
rules: Blue score only after winning the ball in the Red half. A goal counts double.
Red score by playing through the Blue press and getting a shot at the right hand goal.
If Red play long, Blue get a point for the first header or second ball won.
Rotate who presses first every two minutes.
restart: Ball out of play: Red keeper restarts.
Blue shoot: the Red keeper restarts straight away, so Blue must reset the trap.
points: Curve the run: show the ball carrier one way and shut the pass behind you.
Wait for the trigger: a slow pass, a bad touch or a back pass to the side.
Spring as one: when the first player goes, everyone moves with him.
Win it high, then go forward at once.
progress: Add a Red spare player so it is 5v6 and the press must be sharper.
Count the seconds from regain to shot. Aim for under six.
Play 9v9 and award a point for every regain in the final third.

drills.title: Shift, Squeeze and Hold
drills.format: Back four plus two midfielders v five attackers
drills.area: 50m x 36m, one full size goal with keeper on the left, halfway line marked
drills.kit: Red and Blue bibs, keeper in a third colour, balls in the goal
drills.start: Red start with the ball in midfield, Blue hold a compact block
setup: Blue defend the left hand goal: back four (B1 to B4), two midfielders (B5, B6) and a keeper.
Red have five attackers (R1 to R5) with a ball in midfield.
Cones mark a channel 10m wide either side so Blue can see the shift distance.
rules: Red may play anywhere but Blue score points for each win of the ball.
Blue get a point for every full shift where all six players move together.
Red score by getting a shot on goal from inside the area.
Switch roles every four minutes.
restart: Blue win the ball: they play it to a target player, then restart from the halfway line.
Ball out of play: Red restart from halfway.
points: Shift together: when the ball moves, we all move. Nobody stays behind.
Squeeze when it goes back: step up and make the pitch smaller.
Hold the line: stay the same distance apart, arms length when you can.
Talk early: name the ball player and say who covers.
progress: Add a sixth Red attacker so Blue must hold with fewer numbers.
Make the shift a time limit: the block has to move in three seconds.
Play 11v11 and award a point for every compact defensive phase.

drills.title: Pull and Switch
drills.area: 50m x 36m, a goal at the right hand end (7m wide)
drills.kit: Red and Blue bibs, keeper in a third colour, balls in the goal
drills.start: Blue start with the ball deep, Red defend with five
setup: Blue have 7 players (B1 to B7) against Red 5 (R1 to R5) and a Red keeper.
B6 and B7 stay high and wide as the finishers.
Two wide channels are marked, the pull side and the switch side.
rules: Blue must make at least three passes on one side before they can switch.
Blue can only shoot after a switch of play.
Red score by winning the ball and passing it to a neutral target on the halfway line.
Swap which side is the pull side each round.
restart: Ball out of play or save: Blue restart from B1.
Red win it: play to the target, then restart.
points: Pull first: draw them in with short passes, then hit the space.
Look before you receive: where is the free player?
Hit it early and with pace. A slow switch gives them time to slide.
Stay wide and high: the far player must wait and be patient.
progress: Make it 7v6 so Red can recover faster.
Switch must be played in under two touches.
Play with two goals: score after a switch and you get double.

drills.title: The Hidden Runner
drills.format: 3v1 in a grid, then 3v1 plus a keeper
drills.area: 40m x 28m, a goal at the right hand end (7m wide)
drills.kit: Red and Blue bibs, keeper in a third colour, cones for the grid
drills.start: B1 starts with the ball, R1 defends in the middle
setup: Three Blue players (B1, B2, B3) against one Red defender (R1).
A cone gate marks the halfway line, and a goal at the right hand end.
Run it unopposed first, then add R1.
rules: B2 must play first time after the pass from B1.
B3 must start the run only after the ball is played, not before.
Offside applies from the halfway line.
Rotate roles every two goes.
restart: Ball out of play or a goal: B1 restarts with a new ball from the left.
The defender rotates after each attack.
points: Start the run when the ball is played, not before.
One touch from the lay off player: first time, with pace.
Run beyond the defender and away from his eyeline.
First player follows the pass to support the attack.
progress: Add a second defender, so it is 3v2.
Add a keeper and ask the group to score within eight seconds of the first pass.
Play it in a game: award a bonus point for every goal with a third man run.

drills.title: Show, Support, Stretch, Spring
drills.format: 11v7 shape game on a big pitch
drills.area: 70m x 46m, a goal at each end
drills.kit: Blue bibs for our 3-5-2, Red for the opponents, cones on halfway
drills.start: Our keeper (1) starts with the ball
setup: Our eleven in a 3-5-2 against six outfield players and a keeper.
Halfway marked with cones.
rules: Restart from our keeper each time.
A goal from a forward pass in the first three passes counts double.
restart: Ball out: back to our keeper.
points: Show early, before the ball is played.
Open your body to face forward.
Wing backs: width and height.
First look is forward.
progress: Opponents press with three.
Limit our centre backs to two touches.

drills.title: Split the Lines, Three Runners
drills.area: 70m x 46m, a goal at each end
drills.kit: Blue and Red bibs, cones on halfway
drills.start: Red have the ball in our half
setup: Red start with the ball in our half.
Our 3-5-2 defends; when we win it we counter.
rules: Goal within 8 seconds of winning it counts double.
restart: Ball out: Red restart from halfway.
points: First look forward.
Pass through the gap between two opponents.
Three runners: left, middle, right.
progress: Red recover with two players.
Limit to five passes.

drills.title: Lose It, React: Five Seconds
drills.format: 11v7 game with a five second press
drills.start: We attack, then lose the ball
setup: Normal game, our 3-5-2.
rules: A win back inside five seconds is a bonus point.
points: React straight away, no sulking.
Nearest three press.
Cut off the easy pass.
After five seconds, drop into shape.
progress: Bonus only if we score within 10 seconds of winning it back.

drills.title: Build From 1, Then Break
drills.kit: Blue and Red bibs, cones on halfway
setup: Our keeper starts every attack.
rules: Red can only press after the first pass.
points: Back three get wide.
Eight drops to help.
Play out, then go forward fast.
progress: Red press straight away.

drills.title: Every Job, Every Player
drills.format: 8v8 game, roles swap every few minutes
setup: 8v8, our shape is 3-2-1-1 plus keeper (a mini 3-5-2).
rules: Coach whistles every few minutes: players rotate positions.
points: Learn the job of the position you are in.
Talk to the teammate you swap with.
progress: Players choose their own rotation.

drills.title: The Whole Game
setup: Full game in our 3-5-2.
rules: Bonus point for a counter-press win or a counter goal.
points: Shape before the ball arrives.
React in five seconds.
First pass forward, three runners.
progress: Free play, coach freezes for key moments.
